newsitem.title: USA: BHA Group holders approve name change.
newsitem.headline: BHA Group holders approve name change.

text.p: BHA Group Inc said Wednesday its stockholders approved changing the company's name to BHA Group Holdings Inc, effective today.

The change will allow the company to operate nearly all of its business units under a single marketing identity, the company said. The stock symbol on the Nasdaq National Market System will remain BHAG, the company said.
BHA Group Holdings is a manufacturter of industrial air pollution control parts and services.
The company's shares were trading up 1/2 Wednesday at 18.
